62313.name: Sustainer Drive · First Strike
62313.SpecificEffects:
At the start of action, reloads <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo into a random non-exhausted Tactical Weapon.
Tactical Weapon Ammo Capacity <color=#F74848>+2</color>.
When actively attacking for the <color=#F74848>1st</color> time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
